Comparison

Surfer vs Clearscope

A side-by-side look at Surfer and Clearscope, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Surfer when your priority is: optimising individual pages against live SERP data while writing. Choose Clearscope when your priority is: clean, reliable content grading for teams with an editorial process.

Surfer vs Clearscope at a glance

CriteriaSurferClearscope
CategoryAI SEO ToolsAI SEO Tools
Best forOptimising individual pages against live SERP data while writing.Clean, reliable content grading for teams with an editorial process.
Pricing modelSubscriptionSubscription
Free planNoNo
Free trialYesNot verified
API availableYesYes
Platforms
  • Web, Chrome extension, Google Docs add-on, WordPress plugin
  • Web, Google Docs add-on, WordPress plugin, Chrome extension
Key features
  • Content Editor with a live optimisation score as you type
  • SERP Analyzer comparing 500+ on-page signals against top-ranking pages
  • Content Audit for existing pages with prioritised fixes
  • Keyword Research with topic clustering and search-intent classification
  • Surfer AI generating a fully optimised article draft
  • AI Humanizer
  • Content reports grading a draft A++ to F against top-ranking competitors
  • term and topic coverage recommendations with usage frequency guidance
  • readability grading
  • content inventory tracking performance of all your pages over time
  • keyword discovery
  • Google Docs and WordPress add-ons for in-tool grading
Advantages
  • The live content score while writing is the most actionable optimisation feedback in this group - writers actually use it, which is not true of most SEO tools
  • SERP Analyzer's breadth of signals is genuinely deep
  • the AI Tracker for answer-engine visibility is forward-looking
  • Google Docs integration means writers stay in their tool.
  • The cleanest and most trustworthy reports in this category - the A++ to F grading is unambiguous, which makes it excellent for briefing external writers
  • deliberately narrow scope means it does one thing very well with no feature bloat
  • term recommendations are more accurate and less noisy than competitors
  • excellent Google Docs integration.
Limitations
  • Expensive at $99/mo entry for what is fundamentally a single-purpose tool
  • the content score encourages formulaic writing that hits targets without being better - over-optimisation is a real risk
  • Surfer AI articles cost extra on top of an already high subscription
  • credit metering frustrates high-volume teams
  • By far the most expensive option here at roughly $189/mo entry for 20 reports - hard to justify below enterprise scale
  • deliberately limited feature set means no AI writing, no technical SEO, no rank tracking, no internal linking
  • report metering is restrictive at the entry tier
  • no self-serve trial makes evaluation slow

Pricing notes

Surfer

Essential around $99/mo ($79 annually) with roughly 30 content editor credits/month and 1 seat. Scale around $219/mo ($175 annually) with more credits and seats. Enterprise custom, annual, with unlimited credits, white-labelling and a dedicated manager. Surfer AI article generation is charged separately, historically around $19-29 per article or in bundled packs. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Clearscope

Essentials around $189/mo with roughly 20 content reports/month, 1 seat and limited keyword discovery. Business around $399/mo with more reports, multiple seats and content inventory. Enterprise custom, annual, with high report volumes, unlimited seats and dedicated support. Annual billing discounted. Clearscope is the most expensive entry point among the content optimisation tools here.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: Surfer ↗ · Clearscope ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between Surfer and Clearscope?

Surfer: Content optimisation platform that analyses the top-ranking pages for a keyword and gives a real-time content score as you write, guiding word count, headings, terms and structure toward what is actually ranking. Clearscope: Premium content optimisation platform positioned at the enterprise end of the market.

When should I choose Surfer over Clearscope?

Surfer is listed as best for: optimising individual pages against live SERP data while writing. Clearscope is listed as best for: clean, reliable content grading for teams with an editorial process.

Do Surfer and Clearscope have a free plan?

Surfer: No. Clearscope: No. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
